verified_title: LatentWave: JEPA Pretraining for Wireless Foundation Models
metadata_description: Abstract page for arXiv paper 2606.06373: LatentWave: JEPA Pretraining for Wireless Foundation Models
method_summary: Antenna-shared patch projection and time-frequency positional structure enable JEPA pretraining across heterogeneous RF/CSI inputs. Approximately 25,000 samples include over-the-air SDR spectrograms, RF fingerprinting, indoor 5G CSI and Wi-Fi CSI; frozen probes test multiple wireless tasks.
evidence_and_limits: Representation transfer, not action-conditioned packet-service control. Supervised comparisons win several tasks, so the text itself does not support blanket superiority of JEPA.
